slides.title: Golf all day
slides.body: PGA Tour, LPGA, and Champions Tour tee off at 12:00 AM ET. Watch on ESPN+, CBS, and Golf Channel.

slides.title: World Cup action
slides.body: Belgium vs Spain starts at 3:00 PM ET. Watch on Fox, Telemundo, and FOX One.

slides.title: MLB begins at 6:40
slides.body: A full slate starts early evening on MLB.TV, plus select team nets and NBC Sports/Apple TV.

slides.title: WNBA at 7:30
slides.body: Valkyries-Sun and Wings-Tempo tip at 7:30 PM ET. Watch on ION and WNBA League Pass.

slides.title: NWSL closes the night
slides.body: Chicago Stars FC-Boston Legacy FC and KC Current-Orlando Pride start at 8:00 PM ET.
